targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE day >= ((now() - interval '1 hour')::date - interval '30 days') AND day <= (now() - interval '1 hour')::date
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM instance_meta) + COALESCE((SELECT sum(count) FROM expired_instances), 0) AS value

WITH win AS (SELECT (now() - interval '1 hour')::date AS to_d, ((now() - interval '1 hour')::date - interval '7 days')::date AS from_d), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats, win WHERE day BETWEEN win.from_d AND win.to_d ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'docker')  AS docker, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'bare')    AS bare, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'k8s')     AS k8s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'desktop') AS desktop, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->>'platform') = 'unknown') AS unknown FROM latest

panels.title: Version distribution (latest snapshot per instance, last 7 days)

targets.rawSql: WITH win AS (SELECT (now() - interval '1 hour')::date AS to_d, ((now() - interval '1 hour')::date - interval '7 days')::date AS from_d), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (instance_id) instance_id, payload FROM heartbeats, win WHERE day BETWEEN win.from_d AND win.to_d ORDER BY instance_id, day DESC), counted AS (SELECT (payload->>'version') AS version, count(*) AS instances FROM latest GROUP BY 1) SELECT version, instances FROM counted ORDER BY string_to_array(regexp_replace(version, '[+-].*$', ''), '.')::int[] DESC NULLS LAST, version DESC LIMIT 25

WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::date, date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) SELECT d.day::timestamptz AS time, COALESCE(count(im.instance_id), 0) AS new_instances FROM days d LEFT JOIN instance_meta im ON im.first_seen = d.day GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day
